scope: Local parser, migration and source security checks; not a real cloud upload or independent browser sync test
checks: FB2: Cyrillic metadata, nested chapters, formatting and footnote targets
FB2: XML entity declarations are rejected before parsing
FB2: scripts, handlers, remote images, javascript links and SVG do not reach the reader
FB2: structural text anchors survive a second independent parse
Reader: saved highlights survive inline formatting, chapter repaint and comments
Reader: a highlight spanning two paragraphs retains its exact quote
FB2: UTF-16 byte order is decoded correctly
Migration: both conflicting notes and their source/research links survive
Migration: repeated manuscript import is idempotent
Secrets: frontend and server source do not contain constant private credentials
